tasks.label: dw93net: verify NVIDIA environment
args: import torch; assert torch.version.cuda, 'PyTorch is not a CUDA build'; assert torch.version.hip is None, 'ROCm PyTorch is active'; assert torch.cuda.is_available(), 'CUDA is unavailable'; names=[torch.cuda.get_device_name(i) for i in range(torch.cuda.device_count())]; assert any('3080 Ti' in name for name in names), f'RTX 3080 Ti not visible: {names}'; print('CUDA development GPU verified:', names)
